pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:1.1.2: paññapetvā → paññāpetvā (bj, sya-all, pts) | otāpentā → otāpento (pts) | otāpento → akāpento A, otāpento B, otāpentā C. Buddh.: kāyaṁ otāpento 'ti mañcapithādīsu nisinnā bālātapena kāyaṁ otāpentā. (pts note)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:1.2.1: abhiharanti → atiharanti (sya-all) | abhiharanti addasā → atiharanti addasa (pts)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:1.2.2: abhiharante disvāna → atiharante disvā (bj) | abhiharante → atiharante (sya-all, pts)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:1.2.4: tattha → tattheva (sya-all) | ūhadanti → ūhananti (pts) | avassikasaṅkete → vasituṁ avassikasaṁkete (cck: itipi) | tattheva → tattha (sya-all: yu.) | māse → After aṭṭha māse AB insert vasituṁ. (pts note) | tattha → tattha A, tatteva C. B omits this word. (pts note)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:2.1.9: kuḷīrapādako → kulirapādako (sya-all); kuḷirapādako (pts) | masārako → Buddh. (comp. Minayeff, Prātimoksha, p. 86): masārako 'ti mañcapāde vijjhitvā tattha aṭṭaniyo pavesetvā kato. bundi- kābaddho 'ti aṭṭanīhi mañcapāde ḍasāpetvā pallaṅkasaṁkhe- pena kato. kuḷirapādako 'ti assameṇḍakādīnaṁ pādasadisehi pādehi kato yo vā pana koci vaṅkapādako ayaṁ vuccati kuḷiyapādako. āhaccapādako 'ti, ayaṁ pana āhaccapādako nāma majjho (read, mañco) aṅge vijjhitvā kato hotīti evaṁ payato (read, parato) pāḷiyaṁ yeva vutto (see Pācittiya,18). tasmā aṭaniyo vijjhitvā tattha pādasīkhaṁ (read, pādasikhaṁ ) pavesetvā upari āṇiṁ datvā katamañco āhaccapādako 'ti veditabbo. pīthe pi es'; eva nayo. (pts note)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:2.1.13: pañca bhisiyo uṇṇabhisi coḷabhisi → pañcabhisiyo uṇṇābhisi coḷabhiti (bj) | coḷabhisi → coḷabhiti (cck);  (sya-all); colabhisi (pts) | vākabhisi → vākabhisi colabhisi (sya-all) | uṇṇābhisi → uṇṇabhisi (bj: sīmu1, machasaṁ)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:2.1.15: pabbajamayaṁ → babbajamayaṁ (pts) | babbajamayaṁ → pabbajamayaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | pabbajamayaṁ → babbajamayaṁ (cck: sī.) | saṁveṭhetvā → Instead of saṁvedhetvā (pavedhetvā D), which is the reading of the MSS., we ought to read saṁveṭhetvā. Comp. Minayeff's edition of the Pātimokkha, p. 86. (pts note)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:2.1.20: palibodho → The MSS. read constantly balibodho. (pts note)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:2.1.21: santhārakassa palibodho → santhatassa paḷibodho (bj) | santhatassa → santhārakassa (bj: machasaṁ) | santhārakassa → santhatassa (cck: itipi) | santhārakassa → santhatassa AB, saṇṭhārakassa C. (pts note)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:2.2.4: cimilikaṁ → cilimikaṁ (bj) | bhūmattharaṇaṁ → bhummattharaṇaṁ (bj, sya-all, pts) | cilimikaṁ → cimilikaṁ (bj: sīmu1, machasaṁ) | bhummattharaṇaṁ → bhūmattharaṇaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | cimilikaṁ → Buddh.: cimilikā nāma sudhādiparikammakatāya bhūmiyā vaṇṇānurakkhanattaṁ katā hoti, taṁ heṭṭhā pattharitvā upari kaṭasārakaṁ pattharanti. uttarattharaṇaṁ nāma mañcapīṭhānaṁ upari attaharitabbakapaccattharaṇaṁ. bhummattharaṇaṁ nāma bhūmiyaṁ attharitabbā kaṭasārakādivikati. teṭṭikaṁ (sic) nāma tālapaṇṇehi vā vākehi vā katataṭṭikā. cammakhaṇḍo nāma sīhabyagghadīpitaracchacammādīsu pi yaṁ kiñci cammaṁ;... phalakapithaṁ nāma phalakamayaṁ pithaṁ, athavā phalakañ c'eva dārumayapithañ ca. (pts note)
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc14:2.3.4: āpucchaṁ → āpucchitvā (bj) | āpucchitvā → ā pucchaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | āpucchaṁ → āpucchaṁ AB, pucchā C, āpucchitvā D. (pts note)
